evidence_required: A one-page report with a signal table (section, value, baseline), a ranked hypothesis table with tests, the root-cause statement, a remediation order and a validation plan; at least three raw lines quoted from the snapshot.

marking.criterion: Signal table with at least six correct abnormal signals, each with section and value (nvme3n1 48.6 ms, md0, iowait 6.9 %, vmstat b 15.25, CPU0 99.5 % softirq, IRQs on CPU0, 98.9 % NUMA-remote, GPUs 55-60 %)
At least four hypotheses ranked by how well they explain the 40 % loss, with nvme3n1 gating md0 first
A discriminating L2 test with confirming result for each hypothesis
Root cause with contributing factors and a safe remediation order (drain, change process), plus a validation plan with metric, warm-up, repetitions and statistic (key 1.5 + 1.5)

title: CPU utilization is low but throughput is poor
